clips.send: Someone who just got sold a course by a broke 'life coach' sends this to a friend about to buy one too - anger at being scammed by someone with nothing to show for their own advice.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he's watched people call themselves "success coaches" while living in their mother's basement, 80 pounds overweight, raising their voice at their own kids.

He tells the story of his late friend Wayne Dyer - teaching bliss and harmony to packed rooms while privately drinking himself into a hole. Genuinely good-hearted, Kevin says, and still a mess.

Kevin's rule before taking advice from anyone: you can't give what you don't have. Check what their own life actually looks like first.

Who's coaching you right now that you'd never actually trade lives with?
